summary: Do not ship ticket 01 yet: its token foundation does not isolate the new dark palette from light mode.
triage: review-gate SKILL.md rules govern: render EVERY finding as a full table row, the human decides each row (accept/reject/defer/question — free text), echo back before applying, max 2 rounds, append decisions.md and COMMIT it with this artifact.

findings.title: Dark palette changes are installed in theme-independent ramps
findings.body: The branch replaces the shared blue ramp and zinc-700..950 globally. Light semantic bindings later consume those same variables, so light foregrounds, popovers, actions, focus rings, and raw-ramp consumers all change despite ticket 01 explicitly requiring light values to remain unchanged until ticket 05. Dark-only fills are also declared as literals at lines 173–177, splitting the palette between `@theme` and the semantic layer. Building tickets 05 and 10 on this seam would proliferate consumers before light and dark can be adjusted independently.
findings.recommendation: Restore the existing light/base ramps. Define named dark palette and fill tokens under `@theme`, then reference them only from the `@variant dark` semantic mappings. Add a computed-style smoke assertion proving representative light values remain unchanged while dark values use the redesign palette.

next_steps: Refactor the palette seam before tickets 05 and 10 add further consumers.
Pin representative light and dark semantic values at the existing browser-level test seam.
